nodes.name: Printing Letter_Invoices
nodes.notes: Returns one item per account: the letter content plus the account identifiers and email. Set the workflow ID above.

nodes.name: Normalize Account Fields
nodes.notes: Fallback chains cover both Business Central shapes: OData page fields (No, Name, E_Mail, Company_Name, Integration_Customer_No) and API v2.0 fields (number, displayName, email, companyName). Trim to the single real field name once the Printing Letter_Invoices export is available. The email is expected to be the AP contact (Contact table 5050) linked to the customer via Integration Customer No.

nodes.name: Printing Statements
nodes.notes: Runs once per account so each statement PDF lines up with its letter. Must return exactly one item carrying the statement PDF as binary data. Lives in My project / Engelman's Bakery / Printing Letter_Invoices.

nodes.name: Combine Letter + Statement
nodes.notes: Input 1 = letter/account data, Input 2 = statement PDF. Position pairing is safe because the statement workflow runs once per item, in order.

nodes.name: Create Outlook Draft (Do Not Send)
nodes.notes: Creates an UNSENT draft only. The draft lands in the mailbox that owns the OAuth2 credential, so this credential must be gpress@engelmansbakery.com. There is deliberately no 'send' operation anywhere in this workflow.

nodes.name: Skipped — No Email on File
nodes.notes: Accounts with no email address land here instead of silently disappearing. Review this branch after each run.
